image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a vintage-style comic book or pulp magazine lying on a wooden surface. The cover features a dark background with cream-colored illustrations of two figures: one appears to be a woman in distress or action pose, and the other a man running or lunging. The title at the top reads 'MUTLOHA' (or similar gibberish text) in a stylized font. There is a block of smaller, illegible text at the bottom. The image has a greenish tint and visible noise/grain.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The title 'MUTLOHA' and the bottom text block are nonsensical and illegible. The characters are malformed, fused, or invented, which is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.
There is a uniform, noisy grain that feels digital rather than optical film grain or paper texture. It lacks the sharpness of a real photograph of a printed object.

The edges of the illustrated figures bleed into the background slightly. The anatomy of the running figure is somewhat ambiguous, with limbs lacking clear definition or joint structure, appearing slightly 'melted'.
